pages.title: Loom Rush
pages.creator: Sidrick
pages.description:
Loom Rush asks you to draw loops around moving blobs to pop them. Catch several in one loop to increase the score multiplier, but watch the ones chasing you. Touching a blob costs a life, and bouncing red cutters can snap your trail before you close it.

Pick one of three upgrades after each wave. Between attempts, spend the sparks you earn on permanent boosts and try another run with the changes you made.

pages.title: CATCULUS
pages.creator: Raid games
pages.description: CATCULUS combines a grid of numbered tiles with a target sum. Select tiles next to each other and add their values until you reach the number shown. A promising start can leave you without the neighbor you need, so check what the next few tiles could contribute before you choose. The cat-themed pixel art frames a puzzle about mental arithmetic and planning.

pages.title: Dice Puzzle
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Dice Puzzle gives you a grid to fill with numbered dice. Place single dice or pairs where they can connect with matching values and merge into a higher number. Leave space for both dice when a pair comes up, and look for placements that set off another merge. The challenge is to keep making larger values without filling the grid.

pages.title: Tsunami Brainrots Online
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description:
Tsunami Brainrots Online sends you into dangerous areas to collect brainrot characters while a giant wave threatens to cut you off. Decide how far to go for a pickup, then get back to safety before time runs out.

Play a solo run with online chat, or choose the local two-player option to share a screen. Watch for the wave while planning both the trip out and the return.

pages.title: Bloom Within: A life simulator
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Bloom Within: A life simulator follows a woman and her family through pregnancy and the arrival of a baby. Play through everyday care activities as the story moves toward the birth, then take on tasks for the newborn. The focus shifts with each stage, from looking after the mother to caring for and raising the baby.

pages.title: Pew Pew Dose
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Pew Pew Dose starts you with a basic gun and sends waves of zombies your way. Build up the weapon by attaching barrels to one another and adding magazines. The layout is part of the challenge: experiment with where the pieces go and see what the resulting gun can do against a horde. Keep adjusting your build as you look for more firepower.

pages.title: DuaLight - A Reflected Game
pages.creator: Low Pixel Byte
pages.description: DuaLight - A Reflected Game is a pixel art platformer where the path is hidden from your character's side of the screen. Look down at the reflection to see platforms you cannot see above. Use those positions to decide where to move and when to jump. A stretch that looks empty in the main view may be the way forward.

pages.title: Ibiza Foam Party
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Ibiza Foam Party gets Gina and Selena ready for a summer party. Start with scrubs and skincare, then pick makeup and choose what each friend will wear. Use the beauty and wardrobe options to create two party looks. You can give both friends a shared color theme or try something different for each one.

pages.title: Ellie's Recipe: Dubai Chocolate Bar
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Ellie's Recipe: Dubai Chocolate Bar takes you through making a chocolate bar with Ellie. Gather the ingredients, prepare the molds and make the filling before putting the bar together. Work through the mixing and decorating stages to finish the dessert. You can also unlock outfits for Ellie as you play.

pages.title: Strike Force: Action Platformer
pages.creator: BeruGames
pages.description:
Strike Force: Action Platformer is a side-scrolling shooter where you fight through enemy groups and take on bosses. Switch between weapons such as handguns, shotguns, machine guns and rocket launchers as you make your way through the stages. Grenades give you another attack when enemies close in.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, Space to jump, J to fire and K to throw a grenade. On touch screens, use the joystick for movement and the separate action buttons.

pages.title: Jello Bubbles
pages.creator: CheesecakeGames
pages.description: Jello Bubbles is a bubble shooter played with colorful jello balls. Aim your shots to make groups of three or more of the same color and clear them. Look at where each shot will land so it helps open space or sets up another match. The heroine and her bird travel around the world as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Scary BanBan Escape
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Scary BanBan Escape puts you in a deserted kindergarten where monsters are hunting you. Explore the rooms and look for a way out of each level before the creatures find you. Use WASD to move, the mouse to look around, Space to jump and F to interact with objects you find.

pages.title: Holiday Hex Sort
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Holiday Hex Sort lets you drop stacks of hexagonal tiles onto a board. Place them so matching tiles can merge and build piles of the same type. A pile disappears when it reaches ten matching tiles. More varieties appear in later puzzles, leaving you with more choices about where to put each stack. Clear the tiles before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Crazy Motorcycle
pages.creator: AM-Games
pages.description: Crazy Motorcycle puts Nubik on a bike and sends him across a series of obstacle tracks. Ride around barriers and jump over gaps to reach the finish line without wrecking the bike. Check what comes after each jump before you speed up. Each level gives you a different route to get through.

pages.title: Guess The Drawing
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Guess The Drawing turns a drawing passed from person to person into a memory puzzle. Watch what the person behind you draws and try to reproduce it from memory. Pay attention to the shape and position of the lines before making your own version. Coins earned in the game can be spent on new brushes.

pages.title: Family Tree Emoji
pages.creator: Endless Games
pages.description: Family Tree Emoji gives you family trees with an emoji missing. Look at the parents and children around the gap, then choose the emoji that fits their shared features. Some combinations are unusual, so compare the details in more than one branch before deciding which answer belongs in the empty cell.

pages.title: Three Chickens
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Three Chickens sends a stream of chickens for you to place on a board. Drag each one into a tile and line up three or more of the same kind to clear a group. Leave places for future chickens when you choose a spot. The game keeps going as a score challenge, so try to make room for the next arrivals.

pages.title: AquaPark Fun Loop
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: AquaPark Fun Loop puts you in charge of a growing water park. Earn money from the pool and spend it on upgrades that let the park serve more visitors. As the business grows, use its earnings to develop the facilities further. See how far you can expand from the pool you start with.

pages.title: Lovie Chics Black Friday Shopping
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Lovie Chics Black Friday Shopping follows a group of friends on a shopping trip. Browse the fashion options and put together an outfit for each girl. Choose accessories to go with the clothes you picked. Give the friends coordinated looks or try different combinations for each one as you work through the Black Friday wardrobe.

pages.title: Muscle Clicker
pages.creator: Barsuk Studio
pages.description: Muscle Clicker has you train a character at the gym and enter competitions to earn money. Keep an eye on stamina, which runs down as you exercise. Spend your earnings on new equipment to improve your workouts and gain more experience. As that experience grows, you can raise your strength and stamina for later training and competitions.

pages.title: Oscar Red Carpet Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Oscar Red Carpet Fashion lets you style the Rainbow High friends for a red carpet event. Browse the gowns, jewelry and hairstyles, then put together a look for each girl. Try changing the hair or swapping a piece of jewelry after you choose a dress to see how it changes the finished outfit.

pages.title: Counter Craft 2 Zombies
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Counter Craft 2 Zombies pits you against waves of zombies in a blocky world. Use three different weapons to stop the enemies closing in and survive the current round. The rounds get harder as you progress, so keep watching for new arrivals while dealing with the zombies already within range.

pages.title: Brain IQ test Minecraft Quiz
pages.creator: Brosco Games
pages.description: Brain IQ test Minecraft Quiz has you answer questions in head-to-head quiz duels. Win to earn points and climb into higher leagues, where you can keep improving your ranking. Victories can also earn characters in the game's blocky style and rewards called HAKI. Your answers drive the match, so work out the question before choosing a response.

pages.title: Dino Merge Wars
pages.creator: Gamefacto
pages.description:
Dino Merge Wars gives you dinosaurs and humanoid fighters to deploy in battles. Choose which units to send out and merge units to create stronger fighters. You can also combine a dinosaur with a humanoid to make a mounted rider.

Build a force that can defeat the enemy dinosaurs while keeping your Dino Egg intact. Think about how a merge changes the units you have available before the next fight.

pages.title: Head Soccer 2023
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Head Soccer 2023 lets you choose a player for quick soccer matches against a friend or the computer. Move between attack and defense as the ball comes back across the field. Jump to get to a high ball or kick when you have a clear shot. Try a tournament when you want a series of matches to win.

pages.title: Color Match 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Color Match 3D gives you an object whose color you need to reproduce. Mix paint on the palette and apply it to a 3D model, then compare the result with the target. Small changes to the mix can bring it closer to the example. The game grades the match, and the finished pieces can be auctioned or shown in your orchard.

pages.title: Crypto Master!
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description: Crypto Master! is an obstacle runner with a trail that grows as you gather cryptocurrency. Pick up dollars along the course and use them to buy crypto. Steer around barriers as you build up your haul. The game also lets you hold what you gathered or spend it on items.

pages.title: Liquid 2
pages.creator: Feig Ltd.
pages.description: Liquid 2 asks you to guide water to the finish by rotating the entire playfield. Use the arrow keys to tilt the layout and change where the drops flow. Watch for traps as the water moves, and collect extra drops along the way. The puzzles span 27 levels across three worlds.

pages.title: How Dare You
pages.creator: TheShpufa
pages.description: How Dare You follows a monk whose meditation is interrupted by an alien pulling at his goatee. Run as far as you can with your Sensei's guidance, picking up gold and taking out enemies on the way. Use upgrades to develop the monk and see whether the changes help you make it farther on the next run.

pages.title: Smartphone Tycoon
pages.creator: Holy Cow Studio
pages.description: Smartphone Tycoon puts you in charge of a company that designs and makes smartphones. Tap or hold to work through its activities and develop the business. As the company grows, keep designing devices and expanding its place in the market. The goal is to turn the operation into a leading smartphone company.

pages.title: Princess Ella Soft vs Grunge
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess Ella Soft vs Grunge lets you explore two fashion styles with Ella. Try soft colors, comfortable clothes and pink or peach makeup for the Soft look. Then turn to the Grunge wardrobe for a darker, rougher style. Compare the looks as you put together makeup and clothing and decide which details suit Ella.

pages.title: Block Craft 2
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Block Craft 2 lets you explore and reshape a world made of blocks. Use the tools and items in your inventory to build, change existing structures and develop a kingdom of your own. The sequel adds skins, tools and inventory options, so you can vary both the character you use and the world you create.

pages.title: SANTA DART GAME
pages.creator: Game Ashlar
pages.description: SANTA DART GAME turns a Christmas party into a test of aim. Throw darts at the target and get as close to its center as possible for more points. Keep clear of the person near the board when lining up a throw. An accurate shot has to reach the scoring area without hitting him.

pages.title: Freddy Run 1
pages.creator: rungames.org
pages.description: Freddy Run 1 sends Freddy through five haunted castle levels in a nightmare. Jump past traps and monsters, and watch behind you when the Soul Catcher appears. He pulls back his scythe before striking, giving you a cue to jump. Collect gold coins along the way. Reaching 100 earns an extra life for the run.

pages.title: Pop It Jigsaw
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Pop It Jigsaw combines fitting pieces together with pressing the bubbles on the finished picture. Rebuild the cartoon designs and work through more than twenty images. Completing a level earns gold, which you can spend on backgrounds or skins. Try a different look before moving on to the next picture.

pages.title: Super Penguboy
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Super Penguboy sends a little penguin through side-scrolling levels with enemies, traps and obstacles. Help him get past the dangers and collect coins to raise your score. Look for stars as you explore each stage, and try to gather them all while finding a safe way through to the end.

pages.title: Windy Slider
pages.creator: Game Worthy Studios Inc.
pages.description: Windy Slider lets you use an umbrella to pick up speed in a race. Press and hold to point it forward and catch the wind, then release to jump. Land in line with a slope to build momentum for the next stretch. Pass rivals and paint over the lines they leave. Gather enough coins to trigger a burst of extra speed.

pages.title: Nightmare Runners
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Nightmare Runners is a knockout race through courses full of traps and monsters. Stay in the running by getting through each round before you are eliminated. Try a race against other competitors or use the two-player mode to race a friend. Earn coins through achievements and spend them on new skins and characters.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Hello USA
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Hidden Objects Hello USA takes you through 16 scenes inspired by American landscapes, monuments and cities. Search each scene for the objects the level asks you to find. Look across the foreground and background for items that blend into the setting. Finish one picture to continue the tour through the rest.

pages.title: Mermaid Glitter Cupcakes
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Mermaid Glitter Cupcakes takes you from making cupcake batter to decorating the finished cakes. Use the mouse to work through the preparation, then put the cupcakes in the oven. After baking, choose colorful toppings and add glitter to give them a mermaid theme. Finish the batch by deciding how the colors will go together.

pages.title: Cycle Extreme
pages.creator: IriySoft
pages.description: Cycle Extreme puts you on a mountain bike heading down steep tracks. Ride past obstacles and get across gaps without falling in. A fast run can earn three stars, but the terrain makes it important to judge how you approach each drop. There are 20 courses, each with its own downhill route to finish.

pages.title: Colors Game
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Colors Game helps you practice recognizing colors. Look at the color the game asks for and click the choice that matches it. Compare the options before you choose, especially when two shades look close. Each prompt gives you another chance to identify a color from the choices on screen.

pages.title: Greater Lesser or Equal
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Greater Lesser or Equal gives you numbers to compare. Decide whether the first value is greater than, less than or equal to the second, then pick the sign that fits between them. Look at both values before choosing. When the numbers differ, the open side of the comparison sign faces the larger one.

pages.title: Just Draw 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Just Draw 3D shows you an incomplete picture and asks you to draw what is missing. Study the scene for a clue, then sketch the part that belongs there. One puzzle might ask you to finish an animal, while another uses a sports scene or a small story. Work out what each image needs before you start drawing.

pages.title: Stick Tank Wars 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stick Tank Wars 2 is a duel where you aim tank shots before the enemy can take you out. Hold and adjust your shot, then release to fire. Judge the aim quickly as the opponent prepares to shoot back. Collect coins to customize your tank and take the changes into later fights.

pages.title: Metro Bus Games Real Metro Sim
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Metro Bus Games Real Metro Sim puts you behind the wheel of a city bus. Drive through the route to pick up passengers, then take them to their drop-off stops. Watch for the pickup and drop-off markers as you go. The routes change between levels, giving you different parts of the city to drive through.

pages.title: Mega Car Ramp Impossible Stunt Game
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Mega Car Ramp Impossible Stunt Game puts you behind the wheel on stunt courses with ramps and checkpoints. Keep the car under control as you line up for each ramp and aim for the finish before time expires. Passing checkpoints can earn coins along the way. Look where the next ramp leads before you accelerate into it.

pages.title: Elementary Arithmetic Math
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Elementary Arithmetic Math gives you arithmetic questions to solve. Work out each calculation and choose an answer. You can make only a limited number of mistakes before the game ends, so check the numbers and the operation before responding. Keep answering correctly to stay in the round.

pages.title: Dating Party
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Dating Party gets Mia and Bella ready to meet their dates. Help each princess with makeup and pick an outfit for the party. Then look through the available princes and choose a partner for each girl. You can give the two friends different styles as you prepare them for the same event.

pages.title: Soccer Random
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Soccer Random makes a match out of one-button controls and changing conditions. A new round can swap the field, ball, players or goals. Try to score whether you are on ice or at the beach, and get to five goals to win. Play against the computer or share the match with a friend. Player one uses W, and player two uses the Up arrow.

pages.title: Animals Collection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Animals Collection asks you to gather specific animals before time runs out. Start on one animal and drag through its neighbors to make a chain of at least three identical animals. Your chain can go sideways, up or down, or diagonally. Release to collect the animals in the chain. Longer connections earn bonuses, and a chain of more than seven adds time. Watch the requested totals as you choose which animals to connect next.

pages.title: Knife Rush
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Knife Rush asks you to keep a knife climbing from one platform to the next. Watch the moving aim indicator and time your launch so the knife reaches the next surface. Pick up apples to improve your score as you go. The course is endless, so each successful launch gives you another chance to climb higher.

pages.title: Funny Rescue Zookeeper
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Funny Rescue Zookeeper follows Amia after an accident at the zoo. Help her through the rescue and care activities so she can get back to looking after the animals. Use the items the game gives you as you work through her recovery, taking care of the zookeeper who usually cares for everyone else.

pages.title: Dream Dolly Designer
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Dream Dolly Designer lets you customize a doll from her face to the box she comes in. Choose facial features, hair and makeup, then build an outfit for the look you have made. Finish by designing the packaging. Try a matching style across the doll and box or give the package its own colors and details.

pages.title: Santa Xmas
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Santa Xmas sends Santa looking for candy to give to children. Collect as many sweets as you can while keeping clear of the snow yeti guarding them. Watch where the yeti is before moving toward another piece of candy. Keep gathering what Santa needs while finding a route around the danger.

pages.title: Water Crysis
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Water Crysis gives you a set of objects to arrange so water can reach the trees. Rotate the pieces with the mouse to make a path. When you are happy with the layout, press Ready to release the water and see where it goes. Think through the turns in the route before you test it.

pages.title: Arabian Night
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Arabian Night is a game of tic-tac-toe against the computer. Take turns placing marks while trying to make a row of three. The computer looks for a way to counter each move, so keep an eye on its possible lines as well as your own. Block a threat before it can complete the row.

pages.title: Thanksgiving Sweet Potato Pie
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Thanksgiving Sweet Potato Pie takes you through making a holiday dessert in a virtual kitchen. Follow the cooking steps as you prepare the sweet potato pie and work toward serving it. The game focuses on the recipe sequence, so look for the next ingredient or kitchen action as each part of the pie comes together.

pages.title: Ocean Hidden Stars
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Ocean Hidden Stars hides ten stars in each of six underwater pictures. Scan the scene and click a star when you spot one. Find all ten before the clock runs out. Be careful when you are unsure about a shape, because several wrong clicks can cost an extra five seconds.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Hygiene Care
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Hygiene Care follows Hazel through a day of learning personal care routines. Help her change dirty clothes and wash them, then guide her through tasks such as trimming her nails, washing her face and brushing her teeth. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel and the others. The meal activities also include washing hands before and after eating.

pages.title: Desert Rush
pages.creator: Tasty Cherry
pages.description:
In Desert Rush, the animals have to get past their hunters and reach the flag. Connect matching gems to attack, and build longer chains for stronger hits. A chain of at least twelve gems triggers an aerial attack.

The hunter can strike back while you are fighting. Once you defeat it, new chains move your animal toward the flag. Poison mushroom chains can also move it forward, but they cost health.

pages.title: Castle Siege
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Castle Siege gives you a cannon and a castle with guards and hostages inside. Aim at supports so the structure breaks apart and falls onto the guards. Pick the shot carefully to keep the hostages clear of the collapse. Collect treasure for more points, and look for shots that earn crowns by making good use of the layout.

pages.title: X Racer
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: X Racer puts you at the controls of a fast-moving craft. Steer with the arrow keys and look ahead for gaps as the course speeds up. Pick up credits along the way, and watch for boosts that change your speed. Between runs, open the shop to look at ship skins and other options.

pages.title: Quadrant Commander
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Quadrant Commander puts enemies on a coordinate grid and asks you to fire missiles at their locations. Read the horizontal and vertical coordinates before taking a shot. If you miss, the enemy shoots back and weakens your shield. Choose a timed or untimed game and practice on the first quadrant or across all four.

pages.title: Orc Adventures
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Orc Adventures sends a rolling orc through courses with coins and obstacles. Use WASD to steer and Space to jump. Gather the coins, then reach the base to complete the course. Power-ups can help as you go, and E activates the one you are carrying. Look for a route that gets you to the remaining coins without missing the finish.

pages.title: Puzzle Block
pages.creator: The Walking Fish
pages.description: Puzzle Block gives you a board of pieces that slide left or right. Move a block into a gap to finish a line and clear it. Look for pieces that fit the open spaces, and think about which row a move will help complete. Each line you remove gives you more room for the next moves.

pages.title: Cube Jump
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Cube Jump challenges you to make jumps that match the right color. Tap to jump, and pay attention to the colors coming up before you make the next move. The challenge is matching the color while getting the timing right, so look for the next match as soon as you land.

pages.title: Bunny Storm
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Bunny Storm asks you to throw food to a blue monster while a troublesome bunny tries to interfere. Watch the aiming arrow, then tap to send the food flying. Wind can change the path of a throw, so factor it in before you release. Time your shot to get past the bunny and reach the monster.

pages.title: Girls Winter Fashion
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Girls Winter Fashion has three princesses getting ready to ski in Arendelle. Choose a ski outfit for each one, then add a hat, gloves and equipment for the slopes. The wardrobe lets you try different combinations before they head down the mountain. Match the gear to the outfit or give each princess a different style.

pages.title: Drag Racing Club
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Drag Racing Club puts you in underground drag races as you try to become the street racing champion. Beat rivals to earn cash and respect, and work toward winning opponents' cars. Spend your winnings on upgrades before taking on the next race. Improvements give you more ways to prepare the car for tougher rivals.

pages.title: Sweet Baby
pages.creator: Roman Parada
pages.description: Sweet Baby gives you a simple task before bedtime: help a child collect every candy. Look at where the sweets are placed and choose a route that takes you past all of them. The bed is the final stop, so make sure the last candy is picked up before you head there.

pages.title: Spider solitaire!
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Spider solitaire! challenges you to arrange cards in descending sequences from king to ace. Move cards between columns to work toward complete stacks. Think about which move will expose a card you need or keep a useful run together. Complete the layout or play another game to try to improve your score.

pages.title: Shoe Designer Fashion Week
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Shoe Designer Fashion Week asks you to design three pairs of shoes, each for a different event. Work through the designs one at a time and choose a look to suit each occasion. Once you have finished the pairs, present them to the jury at the fashion show.

pages.title: Counting Squirrel
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Counting Squirrel gives you a target number above a hole. Drag the squirrel toward numbers whose values add up to that target. Check the running sum as you choose another number. If you are close, look for the value you still need so the total comes out exactly right.

pages.title: Bite My Fingers
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Bite My Fingers pits you against monsters that can bite when you stay too long. Touch the screen to take them on and react quickly enough to avoid losing a finger. Pick up stars during play and spend them on upgrades. Timing matters when a monster is about to snap shut.

pages.title: Cheesy Wars
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Cheesy Wars has you defend a piece of cheese against waves of alien invaders. Tap to attack and use the weapons you unlock, including a dash and a bomb, to stop enemies getting through. Watch for the next wave while your weapons reload, and upgrade them as the defense gets harder.

pages.title: Sara's Cooking Class: Caramel Brownie
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Sara's Cooking Class: Caramel Brownie takes you into Sara's kitchen to make caramel brownies. Follow the game as it switches between the kitchen and close-up preparation tasks. Use the tools and ingredients it asks for, then work through the finishing steps to see the result. The game guides you through the recipe one activity at a time.

pages.title: Bowman
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Bowman is an archery duel where you aim at an opponent and send arrows across the gap. Choose the angle of the shot and watch where the arrow goes. If it falls short or flies over the target, use that result to adjust your next aim. Keep shooting to land a hit.

pages.title: Mermaid Princesses Dress up H5
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Mermaid Princesses Dress up H5 gives you two mermaids to style. Start with the blonde mermaid and choose a top, tail, hairstyle and tattoo from her wardrobe. Then move on to the second princess and try the items available for her. Mix colors across the two outfits or give each mermaid a look of her own.

pages.title: Infinite Road
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Infinite Road asks you to time the placement of platforms for a jumping box. Tap to stop the moving block so it gives the box a place to land. Watch for spikes and leave enough room for the jump. A safe landing brings up another platform, and the run continues as long as you can make the next landing.
